name: Trafford
notes: RESOLVED IN HIS FAVOUR: started GW1, kept a clean sheet, 2 bonus, 9 pts. The GW1 price-vs-minutes contradiction is settled — price was right. Net +43.7k transfers in. Perri now #2.

name: Tzolakis
notes: RESOLVED: started GW1 and returned 10 pts (5 saves, CS, 3 bonus) with Butland out (arm, no return date). +77.9k net transfers in, the largest GK flow in the game. But HUL has the 2nd-worst defensive ticker (18% mean P(CS)) and every fixture carries the ±15pp band: EP6 range 13.42–19.93. Buying the 10-point spike is buying one match.

name: Kinsky
notes: RESOLVED: started GW1 despite conceding 3 (TOT faced 3.87 xG at Brentford — the round's worst defensive display, not his error; he made 5 saves). Market is selling anyway, net −40.5k. TOT DEFW downgraded 0.98 → 1.14.

name: Horníček
notes: ESCALATION REALISED: started GW1 ahead of Pope, who logged 0 minutes with no injury flag. The GW1 warning — 'FPL pricing a new-signing keeper level with the incumbent is a rotation warning' — was correct. No PL history, so capped per the new-signing rule; HIGH until two consecutive 60'+ starts. NEW is the only club improving at BOTH ends from GW5.

name: Petrović
notes: NEW ESCALATION: Di Gregorio (£4.5, id 615) was added to the bootstrap AFTER the GW1 deadline — a starting-calibre keeper priced level with Petrović. This is structurally the Pope/Horníček setup that just resolved against the incumbent. Petrović started GW1 and has 39 straight starts, so p_start is a decay, not a cliff: .90 → .70. If Di Gregorio never takes the shirt his EP6 is 17.63.

name: Rushworth
notes: RESOLVED: started GW1. COV's three-way is settled on one match; zero PL minutes before it. fixtures.md revises COV DEFW 1.30 → 1.21 (implied 0.95 vs ARS — near league-average, better than assumed). Every fixture band-flagged: EP6 range 11.96–17.84.

name: Scherpen
notes: RESOLVED AGAINST THE GW1 READ: Scherpen started, not Walton. The GW1 model ranked Walton ahead on age/experience — that tie-break was noise, exactly as flagged. Market has not followed (net −1.7k). IPS holds a hard defensive run GW2–5; all fixtures band-flagged.

name: M.Bizot
notes: UNRESOLVED, NEW: started GW1 (90') while Martinez logged 0 minutes with status 'a' and no news. A £4.5 deputy displacing a £5.0 incumbent with 32 prior starts. Market has NOT followed him (net +/-0, 0.1% owned), so this is one observation against a strong prior. Modelled as a genuine split, not a resolution.

name: Martinez
notes: BENCHED IN GW1: 0 minutes, no injury flag, no news — and net −38.6k transfers out, the heaviest GK outflow in the game. Owners are acting on information the snapshot does not carry. Prior is far stronger than Bizot's (32 starts, 95 saves) so partial reversion is modelled, but he is unselectable until the shirt is confirmed.

name: Pope
notes: LOST THE SHIRT: 0 minutes in GW1 while £5.0-equal signing Horníček played 90. Net −8.3k out. Best raw save rate in the pool (2.457/xGC) and it is now worth nothing without minutes.

name: Di Gregorio
notes: NEW ENTRY (not in the GW1 bootstrap): joined BOU after the GW1 deadline at £4.5, level with Petrović. Zero PL history → capped per the new-signing rule, HIGH. 0.0% owned and 113 transfers in — the market has not noticed. Ramping threat, not a GW2 starter.
